t:
Identify the parameters that needs to be evaluated for proposed group in group health insurance.

II. Type of industry
III. Eligible lives for coverage

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. Sales personnel can be seen as grassroots level underwriters for the company and the information given by them in their report could form an important consideration.
II. As the sales personnel have an incentive to generate more business, there can be a conflict of interest with regard to information provided by them.
o: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
Either I or II can be true
e: Correct answer: Both I and II are true (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
In case of dispute, an insured should approach which of the following authorities?

I. IRDAI
II. Insurance Ombudsmen
III. Consumer fora
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t: ABC Insurance has specified a waiting period for coverage of pre-existing disease. Which of the following is as per the IRDAI guidelines?
e: Correct answer: 48 months (from the IC27 question bank).

t:

II. It is manned by by a female health worker, also called the Auxiliary Nurse Mid-wife (ANM) and a male health worker

t: Mr. D is a resident of Thailand and an Employee in a Company employing 35 employees. Under which Health Insurance Scheme shall he be covered?
o: The Civil Servant Medical Benefits Schemes
The Small Industries Employees medical care system
e: Correct answer: The Social Security Scheme (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Which of the following are not one of the common conditions covered in critical illness policies?
e: Correct answer: Cosmetic surgery (from the IC27 question bank).

t: In February _________, IRDAI has brought out 'Guidelines for Standardization in health insurance'.
e: Correct answer: 2013 (from the IC27 question bank).

t: What does TPA in the context of health insurance  stand for?
e: Correct answer: Third Party Administrator (from the IC27 question bank).

A form of pro rata reinsurance indemnifying the ce

t: XYZ Insurance Company wishes to show the development of incremental payments by the month of payment. Suggest a suitable analysis to the insurance company.

Identify the data that is recorded in Policy data table.

I. Policy premium
II. Individual Sum insured
III. Date of birth
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC27 question bank).

t: France has a system of  ______________ insurance that now covers everybody in the nation.
e: Correct answer: Employment-based public health (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
What are the different modes of contact via which insurers can maintain transparency of information at various stages of the policy lifecycle?

I. E-mail
II. Letter
III. Branch visit
IV. Call centre
e: Correct answer: I,II,III and IV (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Claims analysis by sum insured help insurers to:-

I. Point out the utilisation level at different sum insured ranges
II. Identify the frequency and severity of claims from different age bands
III. Point out the high cost location and revising its sales and rating strategies
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC27 question bank).

t: The insurer is liable only if the losses have been caused by the peril insured against.  This is known as ________________.
e: Correct answer: Principle of Proximate cause (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Health insurance is a way to distribute which of the following types of risks associated with the variation of individual's health care expenditures by pooling costs over time (pre-payment) and over people (pooling).

I. Financial
II. Health
o: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
Either I or II can be true
e: Correct answer: Only I is true (from the IC27 question bank).

t: All of the following are covered under standard Personal Accident policies EXCEPT:-
o: Lump sum benefit payout in event of death
Lump sum benefit payout in event of permanent part
Weekly compensation in event of temporary disablem
Lump sum benefit payout in event of permanent tota
e: Correct answer: Cost of treatment (from the IC27 question bank).

t: A normal health insurance policy can help a person to pay his medical bills, but it would not help him to replace his income which he lost due to not attending his job. Is this statement right? Choose the most appropriate option.
o: No, a health insurance Policy also replaces the in
Yes, a normal health insurance Policy does not replace the income lost due to the injury/illness. For that one needs to take an Income Protection Plan
e: Correct answer: Yes, a normal health insurance Policy does not replace the income lost due to the injury/illness. For that one needs to take an Income Protection Plan (from the IC27 question bank).

t: __________ of an insurer portrays the ability to put in place a robust claim assessment process, which ensures that genuine claims are cleared speedily and fraudulent claims are identified and blocked, with steps taken to minimise their recurrence.
e: Correct answer: Claim settlement process (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Identify the organisation that is an  example of public health insurance for employees in India.
e: Correct answer: Employees State Insurance Corporation (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Mr. Prakash is a 50 year old man. He fears that in the coming years he may be affected with geriatric diseases like heart problem, arthritis, etc and may need extra care for the rest of his life. Suggest an appropriate insurance plan that will help him to pay expenses for the extra care for a long period.
o: Health savings or investments linked plan
e: Correct answer: Long term Care Plan (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Critical Illness insurance covers are usually reinsured using:-

I. Quota share basis
II. Surplus share basis
III. Stop loss basis
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC27 question bank).

t: Insurance companies make their customers fill KYC form. What is KYC?
e: Correct answer: Know Your Customer (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Which of the following statements are true with respect to the healthcare system of Germany?

I. In Germany, most of the residents receive healthcare through the statutory health insurance
II. It functions through non-profit sickness funds that collect premiums from members and pay health care providers according to pre-negotiated agreements
III. Employers and employees contribute equally in the premiums
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC27 question bank).

t:
Arrange the health institutions in order of their size (Starting from small to big)

I. Primary health centres
II. Rural Hospitals
III. Community health centres
e: Correct answer: I, III and II (from the IC27 question bank).

II. Area of residence
III. Age in completed years
IV. Age of Spouse
e: Correct answer: Only IV (from the IC27 question bank).

t: All of the following may be covered under hospitalisation insurance policies EXCEPT:-

I. Written premium
II. Earned premium
III. Group size distribution
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC27 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Rs. 1 lakh (from the IC27 question bank).

t:

II. Critical Illness insurance

Arrange the stages of fraud starting from earliest to the last.

III. Frauds during the contractual period

t:
Which of the following products fall into high frequency, low severity category?

II. Fixed benefits cover
III. Critical Illness cover
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC27 question bank).
